## Validation Boundary and Method

The producer's assertions were not treated as proof of correctness. Validation independently:

1. re-extracted requirement IDs from the authoritative PM inventory and historical global
   traceability gate;
2. re-extracted T001–T016, roles, dependencies, and conversion-source applicability from the
   published task breakdown;
3. re-extracted board task IDs and roles from `board.md`;
4. reconciled every planning and implementation row, artifact, evidence file, and final file;
5. inspected the current C-004/C-005 implementation and discriminating packaged-runtime tests;
6. ran the current, unscoped Java 28 clean build and packaged-JAR integration suite;
7. reparsed the final YAML and reran a deterministic independent auditor.

The t22.4 producer checker was run only before the validation mutation to reproduce its 29/29
baseline. Its producer/auditor-separation assertion deliberately expects `passed: false`, so it is
not a valid post-validation oracle. The post-validation oracle is
[`checkpoints/t22.5-independent-check.rb`](./checkpoints/t22.5-independent-check.rb).

## AGT-01 and SKL-01 Direct Closure

### AGT-01

- `LoadAgentUseCase` always delegates after normalizing a null additional-directory list to an empty
  list; it does not bypass the adapter when no CLI directory is supplied.
- `AgentDefinitionLoaderAdapter` starts from configured directories and appends optional additional
  directories before loading.
- `PackagedCliSmokeIT.discoversAgentsFromConfiguredDefaultDirectory` runs from a fresh working
  directory with an `agents/packaged-default-agent.agent.md` fixture and no `--agents-dir`.
- The test requires `Available agents:` and `packaged-default-agent`, and rejects
  `No agents found.`.

### SKL-01

- `AgentDefinitionLoaderAdapter` publishes `report.discoveredSkills()` through
  `ManageSkillCatalogPort`.
- `SkillRegistry` stores one immutable, atomically replaced canonical discovery snapshot.
- `ExecuteSkillUseCase` resolves execution with `findById` and listing with `listAll` through the same
  port.
- `PackagedCliSmokeIT.listsDiscoveredSkillsFromCanonicalExecutionCatalog` creates a populated skill
  fixture, requires `Available Skills:` and `packaged-catalog-skill`, and rejects
  `No skills found.`.

The current Java 28 full build executes both cases inside the five-test Failsafe packaged-JAR suite.
t22.2 independently established the same discriminating flows for the packaged JAR and native
executable; t22.3 then re-signed both rows as DIRECT-CLOSURE.
